## Compliance Terms

| Term | Definition | Audience | Evidence |
|------|-----------|----------|----------|

| PII Redaction | Context-aware removal of sensitive personal information (credit cards, SSN) from call transcripts and audio while preserving non-sensitive context | IT | [EVIDENCE: transcript BDC-Pros-Extended 20:43-22:02] |
